protocol.description:
This protocol provides a method for an embedded compositor to communicate with an embedded application in order to coordinate application surfaces that are to be embedded in the embedded compsitor's own application surfaces.
Note that this protocol is not intended to be implemented by generic "parent" compositors; it is intended as a semi-private protocol between embedded compositors and their clients.

interface.name: wle_embedding_manager_v1
interface.description: The embedding manager provides an interface for embedded clients to request that particular surfaces be embedded in the embedded compositor, rather than forwarded to the parent compositor.

request.name: create_embedded_surface
request.description: Requests that the provided surface be embedded in the embedded compositor's own surface.

arg.name: token

description.summary: token identifying the compositor's target surface

arg.description: This token is a string that will need to be passed from the embedded compositor to the client out of band. The embedded compositor will use this to determine where in the embedded compositor's surface(s) the new embedded window should reside.

arg.name: surface

description.summary: the client application surface to embed

arg.description: Currently only surfaces with the xdg_toplevel role can be embedded, but that requirement may be relaxed in a future version of this specification (and thus, for now, this request will accept wl_surface objects and not be constrained to xdg_toplevel objects).

enum.name: wle_embedding_manager_error_v1
enum.description: Returned from the manager when an error occurs.

entry.name: already_created
entry.description: Occurs when trying to create an embedded surface for a wl_surface that already has an embedded surface.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.description: The wl_surface passed does not have a supported role. (Currently, only xdg_toplevel is supported.)

entry.name: invalid_token
entry.description: The token passed was either unknown to the compositor, or has already been used with another embedded surface.

interface.name: wle_embedded_surface_v1
interface.description:
This interface represents a surface that has been, or will be, embedded into an embedded compositor's surface.
The requests and events on this interface are mostly about moving keyboard focus around and between the embedded surface and its parent, and are similar to how the XEMBED protocol works on X11. Note that there are a few omissions, as other Wayland protocols already handle some details. The parent compositor will use xdg_toplevel.configure to indicate activation and deactivation of the window, and wl_keyboard.enter for a general movement of focus to the embedded surface.

request.name: request_focus
request.description: Asks the embedded compositor to move focus to the embedded surface. The compositor may or may not actually move focus.

arg.name: serial
arg.description: A serial that corresponds to some user interaction that could be a cause for the focus change.

request.name: focus_next

description.summary: focus next widget after embedded surface

request.description:
Asks the compositor to focus the next surface/widget in the focus chain after the embedded surface's content.
This could happen if the focus is in the "last" widget in the embedded surface's focus chain, and the user presses <TAB> in order to move to the next focusable element in the parent.

arg.name: serial
arg.description:
A serial that corresponds to some user interaction that could be a cause for the focus change.
This also acts as a method for the embedded compositor to detect infinite loops when moving along the focus chain.

request.name: focus_previous

description.summary: focus previous widget before embedded surface

request.description:
Asks the compositor to focus the previous surface/widget in the focus chain before the embedded surface's content.
This could happen if the focus is in the "first" widget in the embedded surface's focus chain, and the user presses <SHIFT>-<TAB> in order to move to the previous focusable element in the parent.

arg.name: serial
arg.description:
A serial that corresponds to some user interaction that could be a cause for the focus change.
This also acts as a method for the embedded compositor to detect infinite loops when moving along the focus chain.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Asks the embedded compositor to stop embedding the surface. At this point, the client should assume that the underlying wl_surface will no longer be displayed at all, and should destroy it.

event.name: embedded
event.description: This event notifies the client application that the embedded compositor has successfully embedded the client surface into one of its surfaces.

event.name: failed
event.description:
This event notifies the client application that the embedded compositor failed to embed the surface.
After sending this event, the embedded compositor will destroy the wle_embedded_surface_v1 object. At this point, the client should assume that the underlying wl_surface will no longer be displayed at all, and should destroy it.

event.name: focus_first

description.summary: focus first widget in embedded surface

event.description:
Instructs the embedded surface to focus the first widget in its focus chain.
This could happen if focus is in the parent surface in a widget "before" the embedded surface, and the user presses <TAB> to move focus into the first widget of the embedded surface.

arg.name: serial
arg.description:
A serial that corresponds to some user interaction that could be a cause for the focus change.
This also acts as a method for the embedded compositor to detect infinite loops when moving along the focus chain.

event.name: focus_last

description.summary: focus last widget in embedded surface

event.description:
Instructs the embedded surface to focus the last widget in its focus chain.
This could happen if focus is in the parent surface in a widget "after" the embedded surface, and the user presses <SHIFT>-<TAB> to move focus back to the last widget of the embedded surface.

arg.name: serial
arg.description:
A serial that corresponds to some user interaction that could be a cause for the focus change.
This also acts as a method for the embedded compositor to detect infinite loops when moving along the focus chain.

event.name: removed
event.description: This event notifies the client application that the embedded compositor is no longer embedding the surface, possibly because the embedded compositor is shutting down, or because the user has requested that the particular UI element be closed.
